resources.string: Use a background display (otherwise use the main screen)

Background display requires Android 12+ and an authorized Shizuku shell. Shizuku manages connection and pairing; Helix never enables or pairs automatically. Android 14+ prefers independent focus; older systems or some devices may affect main-screen focus. Both displays share app accounts and data. Lock-screen authentication is not bypassed. Unavailability never silently switches input to the main screen.
Allow moving an app currently visible on the main screen to the background display (may interrupt that app)
Shizuku shell is disconnected. Check the selected connection method in System permissions.
Shizuku is connected; Helix has not been authorized. Authorize it through System permissions.
Shizuku shell is connected and Helix is authorized. Display support is checked when creating the display.
